opportunities.name: City weekend trip planning and share with friend
opportunities.description: For a given city and dates, research city facts (Wikipedia population, timeanddate weather), find a hotel on Booking, pick activities on Viator, pick a dinner on a restaurant booking site, save a summary note, and draft an email to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia, timeanddate, booking, viator, co (restaurant site), notes, mail
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and read population
Search the city on timeanddate and open weather page for temperature
On Booking enter destination, dates, (guests) and search; open a hotel and view Info & prices
On Viator search for activity 1 and open a result; search activity 2 and open a result
On the restaurant site enter location/cuisine, pick date, Find a table, open a restaurant
Write a summary note with city, dates, population, temp, hotel, price, activities, dinner
Compose an email to the friend with To, Subject, Body summarising the plan

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15 2026, Thames boat + Tower of London, Indian dinner, maya@example.com
Dublin, Dec 4-6 2026, Guinness Storehouse + Cliffs of Moher (partial, no dinner/note/email observed)
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17 2027, 3 adults, whisky tasting + Highlands, Scottish dinner, priya@example.com

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search for destination and dates
opportunities.description: Clear the destination on Booking, enter a new city, set dates and guests, search and open a hotel's Info & prices.
steps: Type city in destination box and select the suggestion
Open date picker and select check-in and check-out dates
Set number of travelers if needed and click Done
Open a hotel result and click Info & prices
